sections.content_text: Section 62 - Income from Financial Assets (1) The following income of a person shall be classified under the head “Income from financial asset” , namely:- (a) interest, profit or interest on Government or Government approved securities; (b) interest, profits or dividends on debentures or any other form of securities issued by local authorities or companies; (c) interest or profit due from the following sources, namely: (i) deposits kept in any bank or financial institution, by whatever name called; (ii) any financial product or scheme; (d) dividends. (2) Capital income derived from transfer of financial assets shall not be classified as “income from financial assets” . Moreover, as per
